description_for_human: Search for and request Entra ID access packages

functions.name: searchAccessPackages
functions.description: Search for access packages matching a natural language query. Returns the most relevant packages based on semantic similarity to the query.

functions.name: getPackageDetails
functions.description: Get detailed information about a specific access package including its resources, assignment policies, and eligibility requirements.

functions.name: requestAccessPackage
functions.description: Submit a request for an access package assignment on behalf of the current user. Requires the access package ID and a business justification.

confirmation.title: Confirm Access Request
